name: Earthquakes & tsunami
summary: M6.6 quake south-west of Tual, Indonesia, on 16 Nov and M6.1 on the Pacific-Antarctic Ridge; all PAGER green
state: USGS recorded an M6.6 earthquake 148km west-south-west of Tual, Indonesia, on 16 Nov and an M6.1 on the remote Pacific-Antarctic Ridge on 18 Nov, both rated PAGER green; they were the only M6+ events in the seven days to 19 Nov. An M5.9 near San Juan, Peru, on 18 Nov was also green (USGS). No M7+, PAGER orange alert or tsunami warning, so Normal holds.
for_you: No damaging earthquake or tsunami warning. Follow local authority guidance in quake-prone areas.
rubric_hit: max magnitude 6.6 below the 7 Watch line
why: Large earthquakes can kill thousands in seconds and disrupt global supply chains (chips, cars).
drivers: Tectonics — unpredictable; impact depends on depth, location and building standards.

rubric.alert: PAGER red, or a tsunami causing damage.
rubric.watch: M7+ in the past 7 days, or PAGER orange, or a tsunami warning issued.
rubric.normal: No USGS PAGER orange/red alert and no M7+ in the past 7 days.
